# John Hanacek — Agentic Design Engineer

## Summary
Founding designer and design engineer building AI-native products, agentic
systems, and metamedium tools. Background in spatial computing (Nanome, BadVR),
now focused on tools for thought and emergent AI systems.

## Expertise
- Agentic Design Engineering (building AND designing AI agents)
- MetaMedium / Tools for Thought (Engelbart, Kay, Victor lineage)
- Earth Star Framework (regenerative AI, anti-entropy systems)
- Spatial Computing & XR
- 0→1 Product Development
- Multi-agent orchestration and workflow design

## Current Focus
- Multi-agent orchestration design
- LLM integration and prompt engineering
- Open-source tools for thought (MetaMedium project)
- Earth Star research via Hermes

## Case Studies
- OpenProse (2026), founding design: brand identity, five logo families,
  homepage concepts, permutation styleguides, a WebGL photographic hero, and
  the git-backed JHDesign Review Canvas built to run the exploration.
  https://www.johnhanacek.com/openprose.html
- Nanome 2, XR product design: wrist-based UI and a Spotlight/Follow
  collaboration paradigm for VR molecular visualization.
  https://www.johnhanacek.com/nanome2.html

## Artifacts Produced
Brand systems, logotypes, homepage concepts as live code, design systems and
styleguides, interactive prototypes, WebGL/GLSL shaders, three.js scenes,
canvas simulations, Unity XR interfaces, internal design tooling, interactive
case study pages, data visualization, photography, Blender renders, and
agentic coding workflows. Deliverables ship as working code, not mockups.

## Services Available
- Founding Designer engagements (0→1)
- AI agent system design
- Technical workshops & prototyping sprints
- Product strategy & leadership

## Recognition
- Kevin Kelly (Wired founder): selected John's scenario as his top choice for

- R&D Innovation Award, Aerospace Medical Association (AsMA), 2022
- Founder Institute SF 2020 graduate (CEO of AvatarMEDIC)
